facts.text: Under the Go Idaho! program, admitted Idaho high school and transfer students receive guaranteed scholarship funding renewable for up to four years.

sources.title: In-state scholarships | University of Idaho
sources.quote: The Go Idaho! program provides a guaranteed amount of scholarship funding to Idaho high school and transfer students.

sources.title: In-state scholarships | University of Idaho
sources.quote: Four-year commitment — First-year students receive funding for up to four years, ensuring long-term support through graduation.
